lessons.claim: Treating every analytic comparison as 'PASS/FAIL' calls a discovery a failure. It has to be split by whether the prediction (a) is derived from the model I implemented (implementation_check -- a mismatch is a bug) or (b) rests on an assumption the simulation does not impose (hypothesis -- a mismatch is a result). All 5 of abp-rod's verifications were (a) and hypothesis verification was 0 -- the code was verified but no physics was tested at all

not_verified: this classification was not applied to trap-drag or chain-bend (the next task)
